第47章 现代宁采臣-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

听到吴姜亲口答应帮忙，余振东顿时大喜，一直紧绷的神经也松弛了下来。

他猛地上前一步，紧紧握住吴姜的手，语气激动又郑重：“吴大师！太感谢您了！真是太感谢您了！不管这事最后成不成，我余振东必有大礼相赠，绝不食言！”

余振东此刻早已没了往日的沉稳，连日来的恐惧和无助几乎压得他喘不过气来，吴姜的承诺，无疑是他现在唯一的救命稻草了。

吴姜轻轻抽回手，客气了两句，对于大礼，他虽然也很看重，但也没过于放在心上。

城隍老祖宗当时就说过，只要他接了地府的差事，美女如云不敢保证，日进斗金还是没问题的。

这不，这才多久，他已经拥有了大多数人，一辈子都挣不来的财富了。

余振东接着又哀求，能不能现在就出发，他们一家子实在是等不及了。

吴姜没多想就答应了，毕竟自己有这个能力，还是尽早将厉鬼解决好了。

余振东的家在隔壁省的云市，正好和H省搭界，开车也就是三、四个小时的路程。

吴姜心里忽然一动，云市那不就是二愣子同学的老家吗？看来，事情顺利的话，还能给二愣子一个惊喜了。

既然决定了，吴姜也不磨叽，当即收拾了一番，就准备出发，让他们稍等，先回了卧室一趟。

别的都可以不带，念念是肯定要带在身边的。

“小姜，我就不跟着你们去了，一把老骨头，经不起折腾了，今天我就和积友一起回家了。”老爷子这时开口说道。

吴姜赶忙劝道：“爷爷，您都来绿城了，怎么也得在这儿住几天啊，老爹老妈都说几次了，想让您过来住几天。”

老爷子摆了摆手，拒绝道：“不住不住，住这里太闷了，想找个一起下棋的都不好找。”

此话一出，吴姜就知道，以老爷子的倔脾气，再怎么劝也没用了。

老爷子的性子他最清楚，说一不二，认定的事，十头牛都拉不回来。

只是看老爷子这意思，都不准备上家里去看看了，也不知道老爹知道了，会作何感想。

Hearing Wu Jiang personally agree to help, Yu Zhendong was immediately overjoyed, and his tense nerves relaxed.

He suddenly stepped forward, held Wu Jiang's hand tightly, and said in an excited and solemn tone: "Master Wu! Thank you so much! Thank you so much! No matter whether this thing comes to fruition or not, I, Yu Zhendong, will definitely give you a great gift and I will never break my promise!"

Yu Zhendong has lost his former composure at this moment. The fear and helplessness of the past few days have almost made him breathless. Wu Jiang's promise is undoubtedly his only life-saving straw now.

Wu Jiang gently pulled back his hand and said a few polite words. Although he valued the gift, he didn't take it too seriously.

The ancestor of the City God said at that time that as long as he took on the errands of the underworld, there was no guarantee that the beauty Ruyun would make a fortune every day.

No, in just a short time, he already has wealth that most people will never be able to earn in a lifetime.

Yu Zhendong then begged if he could leave now. Their family really couldn't wait.

Wu Jiang agreed without much thought. After all, he had the ability, so he had to deal with the evil ghost as soon as possible.

Yu Zhendong's home is in Yun City in the next province, which happens to be on the border with Province H. It's only three or four hours' drive away.

Wu Jiang's heart suddenly moved. Isn't Yun City the hometown of Erlunzi's classmate?It seems that if things go well, I can give Er Lunzi a surprise.

Now that he had decided, Wu Jiang didn't hesitate and immediately packed up and was ready to leave. He asked them to wait and went back to the bedroom first.

You don’t need to bring anything else with you, Nian Nian will definitely be brought with you.

"Xiao Jiang, I won't follow you. I'm an old man and can't stand the trouble anymore. I will go home with Jiyou today." The old man said at this time.

Wu Jiang hurriedly persuaded: "Grandpa, you have come to Greentown, why do you have to stay here for a few days? My parents have said several times that they want you to come and stay for a few days."

The old man waved his hand and refused: "I can't live here. It's too boring to live here. It's hard to find someone to play chess with."

As soon as these words came out, Wu Jiang knew that with the old man's stubborn temper, no amount of persuasion would be of any use.

He knows the old man's temper best. Even ten cows can't pull back what he says and what he believes.

Just seeing what the old man meant, I didn't even plan to go to the house to have a look. I didn't know what my father would think if he knew about it.
